history.summary: 99-yr leasehold 4BR at The Clearwater, D16 (Bedok Reservoir), an excellent 350m (4 min) from DT30 Bedok Reservoir MRT, asking $2.15M at $1,398 PSF for 1,538 sqft. Quantum is in the liquid band; reliable 70-txn URA base at 5.72%/yr; PSF ~1% under median.
history.rating_rationale: Solid family-investment profile: $2.15M in the deep buyer band, efficient 1,538 sqft 4BR for HDB-upgrader demand, strong transit (350m to DTL), and a reliable 70-txn URA appreciation series at 5.72%/yr (above OCR baseline). Score_1000 of 585 understates it — the underlying liquidity and appreciation data are good. Main offsets: 2002 build (~75yr lease remaining) and no PSF discount, but transit + quantum + reliable rate carry it.
red_flags: 2002 build, ~75yr lease remaining — lease decay over hold
